text:
Alex K: Heads up — we need to lock capacity for a quick new-cluster bring-up in eu-north-1X. Requesting a short-term pledge of 8 x H100 (80GB) and 16 x A100 (40GB) for the week of Apr 18–24 to run bootstrap and perf validation. Purpose: customer PoC + smoke tests. Cost center: ENG-PLAT-POC. Contact: alex.k@redwood.com :eyes:

Maria P: Got it. Do you have project IDs, expected sustained utilization, and a rough start date/time? Procurement needs duration and VM SKU to attach to the quota ticket.

Alex K: Project IDs: redwood-eu-poc-01, redwood-eu-staging-02. Start: 2023-04-18 09:00 UTC. Expected utilization: ~70% during test windows, spike to 95% for 2 hours daily. Duration: 7 days with option to extend to 21 if PoC expands.

Samir R: Please open a formal quota ticket and include the following template. I'll +1 from infra side once ticket exists. Template:

```
Region: eu-north-1X
Cloud: GCP
Project(s): redwood-eu-poc-01, redwood-eu-staging-02
GPUs requested: 8 x H100-PCIe-80GB, 16 x A100-PCIe-40GB
Start window: 2023-04-18 09:00 UTC
Duration: 7d (option to extend)
Business justification: PoC customer onboarding, perf validation
Cost center: ENG-PLAT-POC
Network contact: tanvi@redwood.com
Owner: alex.k@redwood.com
Rollout plan: staged bootstrapping — control plane then workers, validation runbook attached
```

Tanvi G: Network notes — for the new cluster we'll need a VPC with private Google access and egress pinned to our NAT. Make sure subnet CIDR and firewall tags match existing peering rules. Also: ensure the bastion SG allows 22 from our office IP list.

InfraBot: Reminder: quota checks may take 24–72 hours depending on cloud provider review. If you need faster turn-up, consider reserving existing capacity in eu-west-1 fallback pool. See https://intra.redwood.com/runbooks/capacity-fallback for steps.

Maria P: When you open the ticket include cost estimate and whether this is a committed/ephemeral need. Procurement prefers ephemeral requests go through the temporary-reserve path to avoid long-term commit charges. If you want dedicated reserved capacity, we need a 3mo commit justification.

Alex K: Filled and submitted ticket INC-3456 with the template above and added cost estimates. Link: https://tickets.redwood.com/INC-3456 :thumbsup:

Samir R: Approved from infra for short-term hold. Once quota is approved, use this command to create a reservation (GCP example):

```
gcloud compute sole-tenancy-reservations create eu-north-1x-h100-reserve \
  --zone=eu-north-1x-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=type=nvidia-h100,count=8 \
  --duration=7d --project=redwood-eu-poc-01
```
Replace with the appropriate zone/machine types for A100. If provider denies H100, fall back to 16xA100 and we’ll rebalance.

Tanvi G: Also, add route: allow egress to our S3 endpoints and monitoring endpoints (grafana, prometheus). Ask security to pre-approve the service account used for bootstrap to avoid delays.

Maria P: Procurement responded: initial capacity pledge tentatively approved, final sign-off pending billing verification. Estimated full approval by 2023-04-16 EOD. If we miss that window, plan B is short-term shift to eu-west-2 staging pool (lower latency hit but faster onboarding).

Alex K: Thanks — I'll schedule the bootstrap for Apr 18 09:00 UTC and will ping again once quota is live. Tagging @Tanvi for network handoff during the 2nd-day validation.

Samir R: Pre-handoff checklist for infra handoff (small):
- confirm quota ticket approved and reservation created
- verify instance images and GPU drivers (cuda/drivers/rocM)
- run smoke: `./scripts/smoke_check.sh --gpus 2`
- validate KV cache and prefix caching is enabled in runtime config
- post results to the ticket

Maria P: Added those checks to the ticket. Assigning handoff to Samir and Tanvi for 2023-04-18 10:30 UTC.

Alex K: Perfect. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.

InfraBot: Ticket INC-3456 updated: procurement note attached. Next update expected 2023-04-16 18:00 UTC.
